title: Ghost Setlist
description: A setlist as lit lettering on pure black, each title set along a shallow arc and nothing else on the page. Flick through it and every song swings round the curve leaving cooling outline afterimages like a long exposure, then lands solid at the crest.
intent: One kinetic type mechanic finished to the edge, with no chrome: a title whose speed is drawn as long-exposure ghosts, collapsing into a single lit line when it settles.
